name: ArchLang
description: Floor plans as code: an AI writes a plain-text .arch file and the ArchLang compiler draws a dimensioned plan (SVG, DXF, PDF) and reports what is wrong, with machine-applicable fixes. Tools include compile, describe, lint, validate, fix, finish, suggest, complete and explain. Also hosted with no auth at https://mcp.archlang.uk/mcp.
author: ChanMeng666
